summary: A user's picture, in three sizes and three shapes, falling back to their initials and then to an icon, with optional presence and verification badges.

props.name: src
props.description: The image. Leave it out, or let it fail, and the fallback takes over.

props.name: name
props.description: Alt text for the image, and the source of the initials when there is no image. Without it the fallback is a generic person icon.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter, and the size of the initials or icon inside it.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: status
props.description: A presence dot in the bottom right corner. It carries meaning, so it is labelled for screen readers rather than left decorative.

props.name: verified
props.description: A verification check in the top right corner. It sits opposite `status` so the two can be shown together.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended after the generated classes, so any Yumma CSS utility you pass wins.
